mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or positive return rate < 50% in the lowest 25% FEDFUNDS observations.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.0% signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive return rate > 50% when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% or Rank IC > 0.03 in the tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or positive return rate < 50% when UNRATE down and PAYEMS up.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 3%), monetary policy tightening and profit margin compression lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive return rate > 50% when GDPC1 growth > 3% or Rank IC > 0.03 in the late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or positive return rate < 50% when INDPRO above 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95% of its 12-month average signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return rate < 50% when INDPRO < 0.95 * 12m_avg_INDPRO or Rank IC > 0.03 in the contraction regime.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive return rate > 50% when UNRATE > 4.5% or Rank IC > 0.03 in the weakness regime.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or positive return rate < 50% when both HOUST and RSAFS increase.
